## Flow

```contr-flow
issue -> build: plan
build -> review: PR
review -> build: blockers
review -> merge: green
issue [done]
build [running]
review [waiting]
merge [info]
```

## Sequence

```contr-seq
owner -> lead: fix #696
lead -> b-696: build it
b-696 -> b-696: run the tests
b-696 --> lead: PR open
lead -> owner: D7 in the Inbox
```

## Past a limit

```contr-flow
a -> b -> c
```
